bundle.longDescription: Connect, query, and understand PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and MongoDB with Redrob AI. Desktop query results are read-only in this preview. Identity-verifying TLS uses publicly trusted CAs; private and self-signed CAs are not supported in this preview. SQL Server support is planned.
